name: Consulate enforcer
description: A sadistic Consulate enforcer who torments Nived and hunts for sympathizers of the renegades; killed by Yahenni.

timeline.summary: A Consulate enforcer and an armament automaton arrest Nived for vandalism and shock him unconscious with an energy device.
timeline.quote: Nived screams, seizes, and topples to the ground.

timeline.summary: The enforcer repeatedly shocks and kicks the unconscious Nived while demanding what Yahenni knows about six renegade sympathizers, including Pia Nalaar's daughter.
timeline.quote: I'm looking for six individuals that are sympathetic to the renegades' cause.

timeline.summary: Yahenni drains the enforcer's essence, killing them, feeling their death, and restoring their own body for twelve days.
timeline.quote: I claw my right hand and pull from the enforcer's neck.

relations.note: Yahenni drains the enforcer to death.

pages_say.description: A sadistic Consulate enforcer who torments Nived and hunts for sympathizers of the renegades; killed by Yahenni.
